MediaForge — Convertisseur multimédia tout-en-un
Dépendances : pip install customtkinter
FFmpeg doit être dans la variable d'environnement PATH
"""

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox
import subprocess
import threading
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import shutil
import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import urllib.error
import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List

# ─── Import local doodstream_api ──────────────────────────────────────────────
try:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve().parent))
    from doodstream_api import get_api as _get_dood_api
    DOOD_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    DOOD_AVAILABLE = False

# ─── Répertoire du script ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SCRIPT_DIR = Path(sys.argv[0]).resolve().parent

# ─── Thème global ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ctk.set_appearance_mode("dark")
ctk.set_default_color_theme("blue")

COLORS = {
    "bg":      "#0D0F14",
    "panel":   "#161921",
    "card":    "#1E2330",
    "border":  "#2A2F42",
    "accent":  "#4F8EF7",
    "accent2": "#A259FF",
    "accent3": "#00D4AA",
    "accent4": "#FF6B35",
    "text":    "#E8EAF0",
    "muted":   "#6B7280",
    "success": "#22C55E",
    "warning": "#F59E0B",
    "error":   "#EF4444",
}

FONTS = {
    "title":   ("Segoe UI", 22, "bold"),
    "heading": ("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"),
    "body":    ("Segoe UI", 12),
    "small":   ("Segoe UI", 10),
    "mono":    ("Consolas", 11),
}

VIDEO_FILETYPES = [
    ("Fichiers vidéo", "*.mp4 *.mkv *.avi *.mov *.wmv *.flv *.webm *.ts *.m2ts *.mts *.vob"),
    ("Tous les fichiers", "*.*"),
]


# ─── Utilitaires FFmpeg ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def run_ffmpeg_sync(cmd, log_cb):
    """Lance ffmpeg de façon synchrone, retourne True si succès."""
    try:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
        )
        for line in process.stdout:
            log_cb(line.rstrip())
        process.wait()
        return process.returncode == 0
    except FileNotFoundError:
        log_cb("❌ FFmpeg introuvable. Vérifiez votre variable PATH.")
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        log_cb("❌ Erreur FFmpeg : {}".format(e))
        return False


# ─── Widget : zone de log ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class LogBox(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10, **kwargs)
        self._text = ctk.CTkTextbox(
            self, font=FONTS["mono"],
            fg_color=COLORS["card"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
            wrap="word", activate_scrollbars=True,
        )
        self._text.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=8)
        self._text.configure(state="disabled")

    def append(self, msg):
        self._text.configure(state="normal")
        self._text.insert("end", msg + "\n")
        self._text.see("end")
        self._text.configure(state="disabled")

    def clear(self):
        self._text.configure(state="normal")
        self._text.delete("1.0", "end")
        self._text.configure(state="disabled")

    def set(self, msg):
        self._text.configure(state="normal")
        self._text.delete("1.0", "end")
        self._text.insert("1.0", msg)
        self._text.configure(state="disabled")


# ─── Widget : sélecteur de fichier ───────────────────────────────────────────

class FilePicker(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master, label="Fichier", filetypes=None, accent=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10, **kwargs)
        self._filetypes = filetypes or [("Tous", "*.*")]
        self._accent = accent or COLORS["accent"]
        self._path = tk.StringVar()

        ctk.CTkLabel(self, text=label, font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 2))

        row = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 10))

        ctk.CTkEntry(
            row, textvariable=self._path,
            font=FONTS["body"], fg_color=COLORS["border"],
            border_color=COLORS["border"], text_color=COLORS["text"],
            placeholder_text="Aucun fichier sélectionné…",
        ).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 8))

        ctk.CTkButton(
            row, text="Parcourir", width=100,
            font=FONTS["body"], corner_radius=8,
            fg_color=self._accent, hover_color=self._accent,
            command=self._browse,
        ).pack(side="right")

    def _browse(self):
        p = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=self._filetypes)
        if p:
            self._path.set(p)

    @property
    def path(self):
        return self._path.get()


# ─── Onglet : Vidéo → MP4 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class VideoToMP4Tab(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self._busy = False
        self._build()

    def _build(self):
        hdr = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], corner_radius=12)
        hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(20, 10))
        ctk.CTkLabel(hdr, text="🎬  Convertir en MP4",
                     font=FONTS["title"], text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(hdr, text="Supporte tous les formats FFmpeg : MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, TS, FLV…",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=(0, 14))

        self._picker = FilePicker(self, label="FICHIER SOURCE",
                                  filetypes=VIDEO_FILETYPES, accent=COLORS["accent"])
        self._picker.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)

        opts = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        opts.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)
        ctk.CTkLabel(opts, text="OPTIONS D'ENCODAGE", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 4))
        row = ctk.CTkFrame(opts, fg_color="transparent")
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 10))

        for label, values, default, attr in [
            ("Codec vidéo", ["copy", "libx264", "libx265", "libvpx-vp9"], "copy", "_vcodec"),
            ("Codec audio", ["copy", "aac", "libmp3lame", "ac3"],         "copy", "_acodec"),
        ]:
            col = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
            col.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
            ctk.CTkLabel(col, text=label, font=FONTS["small"],
                         text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
            opt = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(col, values=values, font=FONTS["body"],
                                    fg_color=COLORS["border"], button_color=COLORS["accent"],
                                    dropdown_fg_color=COLORS["card"])
            opt.set(default)
            opt.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
            setattr(self, attr, opt)

        qcol = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
        qcol.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(qcol, text="CRF (libx264/265)", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        self._crf = ctk.CTkEntry(qcol, font=FONTS["body"], fg_color=COLORS["border"],
                                  border_color=COLORS["border"], text_color=COLORS["text"],
                                  placeholder_text="23")
        self._crf.pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        self._btn = ctk.CTkButton(self, text="  Convertir en MP4", font=FONTS["heading"],
                                   height=48, corner_radius=12,
                                   fg_color=COLORS["accent"], hover_color="#3A7AEE",
                                   command=self._convert)
        self._btn.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
        self._progress = ctk.CTkProgressBar(self, mode="indeterminate",
                                             progress_color=COLORS["accent"])
        self._progress.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(0, 6))
        ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="JOURNAL", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=24)
        self._log = LogBox(self)
        self._log.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(4, 20))

    def _convert(self):
        if self._busy:
            return
        src = self._picker.path
        if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Veuillez sélectionner un fichier vidéo valide.")
            return
        dst = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".mp4",
            initialfile=Path(src).stem + "_converti.mp4",
            filetypes=[("MP4", "*.mp4")],
        )
        if not dst:
            return

        vc = self._vcodec.get()
        ac = self._acodec.get()
        crf = self._crf.get().strip() or "23"
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", src, "-c:v", vc]
        if vc in ("libx264", "libx265"):
            cmd += ["-crf", crf, "-preset", "fast"]
        cmd += ["-c:a", ac]
        if dst.lower().endswith(".mp4"):
            cmd += ["-movflags", "+faststart"]
        cmd += [dst]

        self._log.clear()
        self._log.append("▶ Commande : {}\n".format(" ".join(cmd)))
        self._busy = True
        self._btn.configure(state="disabled", text="  Conversion en cours…")
        self._progress.start()

        def worker():
            ok = run_ffmpeg_sync(cmd, lambda m: self.after(0, lambda msg=m: self._log.append(msg)))
            def finish():
                self._progress.stop()
                self._busy = False
                self._btn.configure(state="normal", text="  Convertir en MP4")
                self._log.append("\n{}".format(
                    "✅ Fichier enregistré : " + dst if ok else "❌ La conversion a échoué."
                ))
            self.after(0, finish)

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LIVE RECORDER — Gestionnaire d'enregistrements de flux en direct
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import json
import time
import random
import re
import math

# Registre global des enregistrements actifs
LIVE_REGISTRY = {}
LIVE_REGISTRY_LOCK = threading.Lock()


def _safe_stem(name: str) -> str:
    """Nettoie une chaîne pour en faire un nom de fichier valide."""
    name = re.sub(r'[\\/:*?"<>|]', "_", name)
    return name[:80]


class LiveSession:
    """Représente un enregistrement de live en cours."""

    PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 10

    def __init__(self, session_id, url, label, out_dir, on_update):
        self.session_id   = session_id
        self.url          = url
        self.label        = label
        self.out_dir      = Path(out_dir)
        self.on_update    = on_update

        self.status       = "init"
        self.start_time   = None
        self.stop_event   = threading.Event()
        self.ffmpeg_proc  = None
        self.log_lines    = []
        self.video_file   = None
        self.json_data    = None
        self.rec_dir      = None
        self.thumb_dir    = None

        self.latest_thumb = None
        self.thumb_index  = 0

        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def _log(self, msg):
        ts = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        line = "[{}] {}".format(ts, msg)
        self.log_lines.append(line)
        self.on_update(self.session_id, "log", line)

    def _set_status(self, s):
        self.status = s
        self.on_update(self.session_id, "status", s)

    def stop(self):
        self._log("⏹ Arrêt demandé…")
        self.stop_event.set()
        if self.ffmpeg_proc and self.ffmpeg_proc.poll() is None:
            try:
                self.ffmpeg_proc.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _run(self):
        try:
            self._set_status("fetching")
            self._log("🔍 Récupération des infos du flux (yt-dlp)…")
            stream_url, json_data, file_ext, ffmpeg_fmt = self._fetch_stream_url()
            if self.stop_event.is_set():
                self._set_status("stopped")
                return
            self.json_data = json_data

            title    = json_data.get("title",    "live")    or "live"
            uploader = json_data.get("uploader", "unknown") or "unknown"
            safe_title = _safe_stem("{}_{}".format(uploader, title))
            timestamp  = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            rec_name   = "{}_{}".format(safe_title, timestamp)

            rec_dir = self.out_dir / rec_name
            rec_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.rec_dir = rec_dir

            json_path = rec_dir / "info.json"
            json_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(json_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            self._log("JSON sauvegarde : {}".format(json_path))

            thumb_dir = rec_dir / "vignettes"
            thumb_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            self.thumb_dir = thumb_dir

            video_path = rec_dir / "{}.ts".format(rec_name)
            self.video_file = str(video_path)
            self._log("Fichier sortie : {}".format(video_path))

            # Récupération photo de profil en arrière-plan
            threading.Thread(
                target=self._fetch_profile_pic,
                args=(rec_dir,),
                daemon=True,
            ).start()

            self._record_loop(stream_url, str(video_path), rec_dir=rec_dir)

        except Exception as e:
            self._log("❌ Erreur critique : {}".format(e))
            self._set_status("stopped")
        finally:
            self._set_status("done")
            self.on_update(self.session_id, "done", None)

    def _fetch_profile_pic(self, rec_dir: Path):
        """Télécharge la photo de profil via yt-dlp dès le début de l'enregistrement."""
        self._log("📸 Récupération photo de profil…")
        import tempfile as _tf
        tmp_dir = _tf.mkdtemp(prefix="profpic_")
        out_tpl = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "profil_pic")
        try:
            cookies_file = str(SCRIPT_DIR / "cookies_tk.txt")
            ret = subprocess.run(
                ["yt-dlp", "--write-thumbnail", "--skip-download",
                 "--cookies", cookies_file,
                 "-o", out_tpl, self.url],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=40,
            )
            for f in Path(tmp_dir).iterdir():
                if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"):
                    dest = rec_dir / "profil_pic{}".format(f.suffix)
                    shutil.copy2(str(f), str(dest))
                    self._log("  ✅ Photo de profil : {}".format(dest.name))
                    return
            self._log("  ⚠ Aucune photo de profil trouvée")
        except Exception as e:
            self._log("  ⚠ Photo de profil échouée : {}".format(e))
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def _find_profile_pic(self):
        """Retourne le chemin relatif de la photo de profil si elle existe."""
        if not self.rec_dir:
            return None
        for ext in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"):
            p = self.rec_dir / "profil_pic{}".format(ext)
            if p.is_file():
                return p.name
        return None

    def _fetch_stream_url(self):
        cookies_file = str(SCRIPT_DIR / "cookies_tk.txt")
        cmd  = ["yt-dlp", "-J", "--no-playlist",
                "--cookies", cookies_file,
                self.url]
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"
        )
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("yt-dlp a echoue : {}".format(proc.stderr[:300]))
        data = json.loads(proc.stdout)

        def _score(fmt):
            q        = fmt.get("quality", -999) or -999
            protocol = (fmt.get("protocol")  or "").lower()
            fmt_id   = (fmt.get("format_id") or "").lower()
            ext      = (fmt.get("ext")       or "").lower()

            if fmt.get("audio_ext") == "none" and fmt.get("video_ext") == "none":
                return -9999
            if "ao" in fmt_id:
                return -9999

            if "m3u8" in protocol or "hls" in fmt_id:
                proto_bonus = 3
            elif ext == "mp4" or "mp4" in fmt_id:
                proto_bonus = 2
            elif ext == "flv" or "flv" in fmt_id:
                proto_bonus = 1
            else:
                proto_bonus = 0

            return q * 10 + proto_bonus

        best_url      = None
        best_score    = -99999
        best_fmt_info = {}

        for fmt in data.get("formats", []):
            if not fmt.get("url"):
                continue
            s = _score(fmt)
            if s > best_score:
                best_score    = s
                best_url      = fmt["url"]
                best_fmt_info = fmt

        if not best_url:
            best_url      = data.get("url", "")
            best_fmt_info = {}

        if not best_url:
            raise RuntimeError("Aucune URL de flux trouvee dans le JSON yt-dlp")

        src_ext      = (best_fmt_info.get("ext")       or "?").lower()
        src_protocol = (best_fmt_info.get("protocol")  or "?").lower()
        src_fmt_id   = (best_fmt_info.get("format_id") or "?")
        resolution   = best_fmt_info.get("resolution") or "?"
        tbr          = best_fmt_info.get("tbr")

        self._log("Format choisi : {} | {} | {} | {} | {}".format(
            src_fmt_id, src_ext, src_protocol, resolution,
            "{}kbps".format(int(tbr)) if tbr else "tbr=?"))
        self._log("Score selection : {}  (qualite={})".format(
            best_score, best_fmt_info.get("quality", "?")))
        self._log("Sortie : .ts / mpegts (conteneur live universel)")

        return best_url, data, "ts", "mpegts"

    def _thumb_worker(self):
        while not self.stop_event.is_set():
            for _ in range(self.PREVIEW_INTERVAL):
                if self.stop_event.is_set():
                    return
                time.sleep(1)

            if not self.video_file or not os.path.isfile(self.video_file):
                continue
            if os.path.getsize(self.video_file) < 50_000:
                continue

            self.thumb_index += 1
            out_path = str(self.thumb_dir / "thumb_{:05d}.jpg".format(self.thumb_index))

            cmd = [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                "-sseof", "-3",
                "-i", self.video_file,
                "-frames:v", "1",
                "-q:v", "3",
                "-vf", "scale=320:-2",
                out_path,
            ]
            try:
                ret = subprocess.run(
                    cmd,
                    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    timeout=15,
                )
                if ret.returncode == 0 and os.path.isfile(out_path):
                    self.latest_thumb = out_path
                    self.on_update(self.session_id, "new_thumb", out_path)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _record_loop(self, stream_url, video_path, ffmpeg_fmt="mpegts", rec_dir=None):
        MAX_SEGMENT_SEC = 30 * 60   # 30 minutes
        retry_seconds   = 20
        self._set_status("recording")
        self.start_time = time.time()
        segment_index   = 0

        thumb_t = threading.Thread(target=self._thumb_worker, daemon=True)
        thumb_t.start()

        while not self.stop_event.is_set():
            # ── Nom du segment courant ──
            if segment_index == 0:
                current_video = video_path
            else:
                base = Path(video_path)
                current_video = str(
                    base.parent / "{}_part{:02d}{}".format(
                        base.stem, segment_index + 1, base.suffix)
                )
            self.video_file = current_video

            self._log("Lancement ffmpeg… segment {} → {}".format(
                segment_index + 1, Path(current_video).name))

            cmd_rec = [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                "-i", stream_url,
                "-c", "copy",
                "-t", str(MAX_SEGMENT_SEC),   # ← limite 30 min
                "-f", "mpegts",
                current_video,
            ]
            try:
                self.ffmpeg_proc = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd_rec,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                )
            except FileNotFoundError:
                self._log("❌ ffmpeg introuvable")
                break

            for line in self.ffmpeg_proc.stdout:
                line = line.rstrip()
                if line:
                    self._log(line)
                if self.stop_event.is_set():
                    self.ffmpeg_proc.terminate()
                    break

            self.ffmpeg_proc.wait()
            rc = self.ffmpeg_proc.returncode

            # ── Post-process TOUJOURS lancé si le fichier existe ──────────
            if os.path.isfile(current_video):
                size_mb = os.path.getsize(current_video) / (1024 * 1024)
                self._log("✅ Segment {} sauvegardé ({:.1f} Mo)".format(
                    segment_index + 1, size_mb))
                if rec_dir:
                    seg_path = current_video
                    threading.Thread(
                        target=self._post_process,
                        args=(seg_path, rec_dir),
                        daemon=True,
                    ).start()

            if self.stop_event.is_set():
                self._log("⏹ Enregistrement arrêté — post-processing en cours…")
                break

            segment_index += 1

            # Re-fetch URL pour le prochain segment
            self._log("🔄 Re-fetch URL pour le segment {}…".format(segment_index + 1))
            self._set_status("fetching")
            attempt = 0
            while not self.stop_event.is_set():
                attempt += 1
                try:
                    stream_url, _, _ext, _fmt = self._fetch_stream_url()
                    self._log("✅ URL segment {} obtenue.".format(segment_index + 1))
                    self._set_status("recording")
                    break
                except Exception as e:
                    self._log("❌ Tentative {} : {} — attente {}s…".format(
                        attempt, e, retry_seconds))
                    self._set_status("retrying")
                    for i in range(retry_seconds):
                        if self.stop_event.is_set():
                            break
                        time.sleep(1)
                        self.on_update(self.session_id, "retry_countdown",
                                       retry_seconds - i - 1)

    def _post_process(self, video_path, rec_dir):
        self._log("\n🎞 Post-processing…")
        dur_cmd = ["ffprobe", "-v", "quiet", "-print_format", "json",
                   "-show_format", video_path]
        try:
            res      = subprocess.run(dur_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
            probe    = json.loads(res.stdout)
            duration = float(probe.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0))
        except Exception:
            duration = 0
        self._log("  Durée vidéo : {:.1f} s".format(duration))

        if duration > 2:
            rand_t   = random.uniform(1, max(duration - 1, 2))
            rand_img = str(rec_dir / "snapshot_random.jpg")
            ret = subprocess.run([
                "ffmpeg", "-y", "-ss", str(rand_t), "-i", video_path,
                "-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", "2", rand_img,
            ], capture_output=True)
            if ret.returncode == 0:
                self._log("  📸 Snapshot aléatoire : {}".format(rand_img))
        else:
            self._log("  ⚠ Vidéo trop courte pour snapshot")

        if duration > 5:
            cols, rows     = 6, 6
            total          = cols * rows
            CELL_W         = 320
            CELL_H         = 180
            sprite_path    = str(rec_dir / "sprite_6x6.jpg")

            step       = duration / total
            timestamps = [step * (i + 0.5) for i in range(total)]

            import tempfile as _tf
            import shutil as _sh
            tmp_frames_dir = None
            try:
                tmp_frames_dir = _tf.mkdtemp(prefix="sprite_")
                ok_frames  = 0
                last_good  = None
                frame_paths = []

                for i, ts in enumerate(timestamps):
                    frame_path = os.path.join(tmp_frames_dir, "f_{:02d}.jpg".format(i))
                    ret_f = subprocess.run([
                        "ffmpeg", "-y",
                        "-ss", "{:.6f}".format(ts),
                        "-i", video_path,
                        "-frames:v", "1",
                        "-vf", (
                            "scale={w}:{h}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
                            "pad={w}:{h}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=black"
                        ).format(w=CELL_W, h=CELL_H),
                        "-q:v", "2",
                        frame_path,
                    ], capture_output=True, timeout=30)

                    if ret_f.returncode == 0 and os.path.isfile(frame_path):
                        ok_frames += 1
                        last_good  = frame_path
                        frame_paths.append(frame_path)
                    elif last_good:
                        _sh.copy2(last_good, frame_path)
                        ok_frames += 1
                        frame_paths.append(frame_path)
                    else:
                        frame_paths.append(None)

                self._log("  {} frames extraites sur {}".format(ok_frames, total))

                if ok_frames > 0:
                    try:
                        from PIL import Image as _PILImg, ImageDraw as _PILDraw
                        sprite = _PILImg.new("RGB",
                            (CELL_W * cols, CELL_H * rows), (10, 10, 20))
                        draw = _PILDraw.Draw(sprite)
                        for idx, fp in enumerate(frame_paths):
                            col = idx % cols
                            row = idx // rows
                            ts  = timestamps[idx]
                            tc_h = int(ts // 3600)
                            tc_m = int((ts % 3600) // 60)
                            tc_s = int(ts % 60)
                            tc   = "{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d}".format(tc_h, tc_m, tc_s)
                            x0   = col * CELL_W
                            y0   = row * CELL_H
                            if fp and os.path.isfile(fp):
                                try:
                                    cell = _PILImg.open(fp).resize(
                                        (CELL_W, CELL_H), _PILImg.LANCZOS)
                                    sprite.paste(cell, (x0, y0))
                                except Exception:
                                    pass
                            tx = x0 + 5
                            ty = y0 + CELL_H - 22
                            draw.text((tx + 1, ty + 1), tc, fill=(0, 0, 0))
                            draw.text((tx,     ty    ), tc, fill=(0, 255, 120))
                        sprite.save(sprite_path, "JPEG", quality=88)
                        self._log("  Sprite 6x6 (1920x1080, step={:.1f}s, Pillow) : {}".format(
                            step, sprite_path))
                    except ImportError:
                        pattern  = os.path.join(tmp_frames_dir, "f_%02d.jpg")
                        ret_tile = subprocess.run([
                            "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", pattern,
                            "-frames:v", "1",
                            "-vf", "tile={}x{}".format(cols, rows),
                            "-q:v", "2", sprite_path,
                        ], capture_output=True)
                        if ret_tile.returncode == 0 and os.path.isfile(sprite_path):
                            self._log("  Sprite 6x6 (1920x1080, step={:.1f}s, ffmpeg) : {}".format(
                                step, sprite_path))
                        else:
                            self._log("  Assemblage sprite echoue (installez Pillow pour timecodes)")
            except Exception as e_sprite:
                self._log("  Sprite echoue : {}".format(e_sprite))
            finally:
                if tmp_frames_dir:
                    _sh.rmtree(tmp_frames_dir, ignore_errors=True)

        # ── Extraction audio compressé ────────────────────────────────────
        self._log("\n🎵 Extraction audio…")
        audio_path = str(Path(video_path).parent / (Path(video_path).stem + "_audio.m4a"))
        cmd_audio = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-i", video_path,
            "-vn",                      # pas de vidéo
            "-c:a", "aac",              # codec AAC
            "-b:a", "48k",              # bitrate 48kbps — léger + lisible par Whisper
            "-ac", "1",                 # mono (suffit pour la parole)
            "-ar", "16000",             # 16kHz (fréquence optimale pour Whisper)
            audio_path,
        ]
        try:
            ret_audio = subprocess.run(cmd_audio, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
            if ret_audio.returncode == 0 and os.path.isfile(audio_path):
                size_kb = os.path.getsize(audio_path) // 1024
                self._log("  ✅ Audio : {} ({} Ko)".format(
                    Path(audio_path).name, size_kb))
            else:
                self._log("  ⚠ Extraction audio échouée")
        except Exception as e:
            self._log("  ⚠ Audio erreur : {}".format(e))

        self._log("✅ Post-processing terminé.")
        self.on_update(self.session_id, "post_done", str(rec_dir))


# ─── Onglet : Enregistrement Live ────────────────────────────────────────────

class LiveRecorderTab(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master, registry_tab=None):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self._registry_tab = registry_tab
        self._build()

    def set_registry_tab(self, tab):
        self._registry_tab = tab

    def _build(self):
        hdr = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], corner_radius=12)
        hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(20, 10))
        title_row = ctk.CTkFrame(hdr, fg_color="transparent")
        title_row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(title_row, text="🔴  Live Recorder",
                     font=FONTS["title"], text_color="#FF4444").pack(side="left")
        badge = ctk.CTkFrame(title_row, fg_color="#FF4444", corner_radius=20)
        badge.pack(side="left", padx=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(badge, text="yt-dlp + FFmpeg", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color="white").pack(padx=10, pady=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(
            hdr,
            text=("Collez l'URL d'un live (TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, etc.)\n"
                  "Enregistrement .ts  •  Aperçu toutes les 10 s  •  Retry auto 20 s\n"
                  "À l'arrêt : snapshot aléatoire + sprite 6×6 générés automatiquement"),
            font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"], justify="left",
        ).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=(0, 14))

        url_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        url_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)
        ctk.CTkLabel(url_frame, text="URL DU LIVE", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 2))
        url_row = ctk.CTkFrame(url_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        url_row.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 10))
        self._url_var = tk.StringVar()
        ctk.CTkEntry(
            url_row, textvariable=self._url_var, font=FONTS["body"],
            fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
            text_color=COLORS["text"], height=40,
            placeholder_text="https://www.tiktok.com/@user/live  ou  https://youtube.com/…",
        ).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 8))
        ctk.CTkButton(url_row, text="📋 Coller", width=80, height=40,
                      font=FONTS["body"], corner_radius=8,
                      fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
                      command=self._paste_url).pack(side="right")

        opt_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        opt_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)
        ctk.CTkLabel(opt_frame, text="OPTIONS", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 4))
        opt_row = ctk.CTkFrame(opt_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        opt_row.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 10))

        c1 = ctk.CTkFrame(opt_row, fg_color="transparent")
        c1.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c1, text="Dossier de sortie", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        dir_row = ctk.CTkFrame(c1, fg_color="transparent")
        dir_row.pack(fill="x")
        self._out_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(SCRIPT_DIR / "lives"))
        ctk.CTkEntry(dir_row, textvariable=self._out_var, font=FONTS["small"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 4))
        ctk.CTkButton(dir_row, text="📁", width=36, height=30,
                      fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
                      command=self._pick_dir).pack(side="right")

        c2 = ctk.CTkFrame(opt_row, fg_color="transparent")
        c2.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c2, text="Nom / Label (optionnel)", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        self._label_var = tk.StringVar()
        ctk.CTkEntry(c2, textvariable=self._label_var, font=FONTS["body"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"],
                     placeholder_text="ex: TikTok Rose live").pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        self._btn = ctk.CTkButton(
            self, text="  🔴  Démarrer l'enregistrement",
            font=("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"), height=52, corner_radius=12,
            fg_color="#CC2222", hover_color="#991111", command=self._start,
        )
        self._btn.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=12)

        ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="JOURNAL", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=24)
        self._log = LogBox(self)
        self._log.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(4, 20))

    def _paste_url(self):
        try:
            self._url_var.set(self.clipboard_get())
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _pick_dir(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory()
        if d:
            self._out_var.set(d)

    def _start(self):
        url = self._url_var.get().strip()
        if not url:
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Veuillez entrer une URL.")
            return
        label   = self._label_var.get().strip() or url[:50]
        out_dir = self._out_var.get().strip() or str(SCRIPT_DIR / "lives")

        session_id = "live_{}".format(int(time.time() * 1000))
        self._log.clear()
        self._log.append("🚀 Démarrage session {}".format(session_id))
        self._log.append("   URL    : {}".format(url))
        self._log.append("   Sortie : {}".format(out_dir))

        def on_update(sid, event, data):
            if event == "log":
                self.after(0, lambda m=data: self._log.append(m))
            elif event == "done":
                self.after(0, lambda: self._log.append("\n✅ Session {} terminée.".format(sid)))

        sess = LiveSession(session_id, url, label, out_dir, on_update)
        with LIVE_REGISTRY_LOCK:
            LIVE_REGISTRY[session_id] = sess

        if self._registry_tab:
            self.after(200, lambda: self._registry_tab.refresh())


# ─── Onglet : Moniteur des enregistrements ───────────────────────────────────

class LiveMonitorTab(ctk.CTkFrame):
    CARD_THUMB_W = 200
    CARD_THUMB_H = 355

    def __init__(self, master):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self._cards = {}
        self._tk_images = {}
        self._build()
        self._poll()

    def _build(self):
        hdr = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], corner_radius=12)
        hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(20, 10))
        hdr_row = ctk.CTkFrame(hdr, fg_color="transparent")
        hdr_row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(hdr_row, text="📡  Enregistrements en cours",
                     font=FONTS["title"], text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(side="left")
        ctk.CTkButton(hdr_row, text="🔄 Rafraîchir", width=120, height=34,
                      font=FONTS["body"], corner_radius=8,
                      fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
                      command=self.refresh).pack(side="right")

        self._scroll = ctk.CTkScrollableFrame(self, fg_color="transparent", corner_radius=0)
        self._scroll.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(0, 20))

        self._empty_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
            self._scroll,
            text="Aucun enregistrement en cours.\nDémarrez un live depuis l'onglet 🔴 Live Recorder.",
            font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["muted"], justify="center",
        )
        self._empty_lbl.pack(pady=60)

    def refresh(self):
        with LIVE_REGISTRY_LOCK:
            sessions = dict(LIVE_REGISTRY)

        to_remove = [sid for sid in self._cards if sid not in sessions]
        for sid in to_remove:
            self._cards.pop(sid)["frame"].destroy()
            self._tk_images.pop(sid, None)

        for sid, sess in sessions.items():
            if sid not in self._cards:
                self._create_card(sid, sess)

        for sid, sess in sessions.items():
            if sid in self._cards:
                self._update_card(sid, sess)

        if sessions:
            self._empty_lbl.pack_forget()
        else:
            self._empty_lbl.pack(pady=60)

    def _create_card(self, sid, sess):
        jd       = sess.json_data or {}
        title    = (jd.get("title") or sess.label or "—")[:80]
        creator  = jd.get("creator") or jd.get("uploader") or "—"
        fmts     = jd.get("formats", [])
        best_fmt = max(fmts, key=lambda f: f.get("quality") or -1) if fmts else {}
        quality  = best_fmt.get("resolution") or best_fmt.get("format") or "—"
        fmt_id   = best_fmt.get("format_id") or best_fmt.get("ext") or "—"
        tbr_val  = best_fmt.get("tbr")
        tbr_str  = "{} kbps".format(int(tbr_val)) if tbr_val else "—"

        frame = ctk.CTkFrame(
            self._scroll, fg_color=COLORS["card"],
            corner_radius=14, border_width=1, border_color=COLORS["border"],
        )
        frame.pack(fill="x", pady=8, padx=4)

        body = ctk.CTkFrame(frame, fg_color="transparent")
        body.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=14)

        thumb_col = ctk.CTkFrame(body, fg_color=COLORS["border"], corner_radius=10,
                                 width=self.CARD_THUMB_W, height=self.CARD_THUMB_H)
        thumb_col.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 14))
        thumb_col.pack_propagate(False)

        placeholder = ctk.CTkLabel(
            thumb_col,
            text="📷\n\nAperçu live\ndisponible\ndans ~10 s",
            font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"], justify="center",
        )
        placeholder.place(relx=0.5, rely=0.5, anchor="center")

        img_label = tk.Label(thumb_col, bg="#2A2F42", bd=0, cursor="hand2")

        thumb_ts_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(thumb_col, text="", font=FONTS["small"],
                                     text_color=COLORS["muted"], fg_color=COLORS["border"])
        thumb_ts_lbl.place(relx=0.0, rely=1.0, anchor="sw", x=6, y=-4)

        info_col = ctk.CTkFrame(body, fg_color="transparent")
        info_col.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)

        row1 = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        row1.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 6))

        dot = ctk.CTkLabel(row1, text="●", font=("Segoe UI", 18),
                            text_color=COLORS["error"])
        dot.pack(side="left")

        status_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(row1, text="🔴 En cours",
                                   font=FONTS["heading"], text_color=COLORS["error"])
        status_lbl.pack(side="left", padx=8)

        elapsed_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(row1, text="00:00:00",
                                    font=("Consolas", 18, "bold"),
                                    text_color=COLORS["accent"])
        elapsed_lbl.pack(side="right")

        sep = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color=COLORS["border"], height=1)
        sep.pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        title_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
            info_col, text=title,
            font=("Segoe UI", 13, "bold"), text_color=COLORS["text"],
            wraplength=480, justify="left",
        )
        title_lbl.pack(anchor="w", pady=(4, 2))

        creator_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
            info_col, text="👤  {}".format(creator),
            font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["accent2"],
        )
        creator_lbl.pack(anchor="w", pady=1)

        meta_row = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        meta_row.pack(anchor="w", pady=4)

        for badge_text, badge_color in [
            ("📐 {}".format(quality), COLORS["accent"]),
            ("🎞 {}".format(fmt_id),  COLORS["accent3"]),
            ("📶 {}".format(tbr_str), COLORS["warning"]),
        ]:
            b = ctk.CTkFrame(meta_row, fg_color=badge_color, corner_radius=20)
            b.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 6))
            ctk.CTkLabel(b, text=badge_text, font=FONTS["small"],
                         text_color="white").pack(padx=10, pady=3)

        url_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
            info_col,
            text="🔗  {}".format(sess.url[:70]),
            font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
        )
        url_lbl.pack(anchor="w", pady=(6, 2))

        prog = ctk.CTkProgressBar(info_col, mode="indeterminate",
                                   progress_color=COLORS["error"], height=6)
        prog.pack(fill="x", pady=6)
        prog.start()

        btn_row = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        btn_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6, 0))

        stop_btn = ctk.CTkButton(
            btn_row, text="⏹  Arrêter l'enregistrement",
            font=FONTS["heading"], height=40, corner_radius=10,
            fg_color=COLORS["error"], hover_color="#CC2222",
            command=lambda s=sid: self._stop_session(s),
        )
        stop_btn.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)

        del_btn = ctk.CTkButton(
            btn_row, text="🗑", width=40, height=40,
            font=FONTS["body"], corner_radius=10,
            fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
            command=lambda s=sid: self._remove_session(s),
        )
        del_btn.pack(side="right", padx=(6, 0))

        self._cards[sid] = {
            "frame":        frame,
            "dot":          dot,
            "status_lbl":   status_lbl,
            "elapsed_lbl":  elapsed_lbl,
            "prog":         prog,
            "stop_btn":     stop_btn,
            "img_label":    img_label,
            "thumb_col":    thumb_col,
            "placeholder":  placeholder,
            "thumb_ts_lbl": thumb_ts_lbl,
            "title_lbl":    title_lbl,
            "creator_lbl":  creator_lbl,
        }

        orig = sess.on_update
        def patched(s_id, event, data, _orig=orig):
            _orig(s_id, event, data)
            if event == "new_thumb":
                self.after(0, lambda p=data, s=s_id: self._load_thumb(s, p))
            elif event in ("status", "retry_countdown", "done"):
                self.after(0, lambda s=s_id: self._update_card(
                    s_id, LIVE_REGISTRY.get(s_id)))
        sess.on_update = patched

    def _load_thumb(self, sid, path):
        if sid not in self._cards:
            return
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            return
        try:
            try:
                from PIL import Image as PILImage, ImageTk
                img  = PILImage.open(path)
                tw, th = self.CARD_THUMB_W, self.CARD_THUMB_H
                img.thumbnail((tw, th), PILImage.LANCZOS)
                photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(img)
            except ImportError:
                ppm_path = path + ".ppm"
                subprocess.run(
                    ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", path,
                     "-vf", "scale={}:{}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease".format(
                         self.CARD_THUMB_W, self.CARD_THUMB_H),
                     ppm_path],
                    capture_output=True, timeout=5,
                )
                if not os.path.isfile(ppm_path):
                    return
                photo = tk.PhotoImage(file=ppm_path)
                try:
                    os.remove(ppm_path)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            c = self._cards[sid]
            il = c["img_label"]
            il.configure(image=photo)
            il.image = photo
            self._tk_images[sid] = photo

            il.place(x=0, y=0,
                     width=self.CARD_THUMB_W,
                     height=self.CARD_THUMB_H)

            ts = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
            c["thumb_ts_lbl"].configure(text=ts)

        except Exception:
            pass

    def _update_card(self, sid, sess):
        if sess is None or sid not in self._cards:
            return
        c = self._cards[sid]

        status_colors = {
            "init":      COLORS["muted"],
            "fetching":  COLORS["warning"],
            "recording": COLORS["error"],
            "retrying":  COLORS["warning"],
            "stopped":   COLORS["muted"],
            "done":      COLORS["success"],
        }
        status_labels = {
            "init":      "⚙ Initialisation",
            "fetching":  "🔍 Récupération flux",
            "recording": "🔴 En cours",
            "retrying":  "🔄 Retry…",
            "stopped":   "⏹ Arrêté",
            "done":      "✅ Terminé",
        }
        color = status_colors.get(sess.status, COLORS["muted"])
        c["dot"].configure(text_color=color)
        c["status_lbl"].configure(
            text=status_labels.get(sess.status, sess.status),
            text_color=color,
        )

        if sess.start_time:
            elapsed = int(time.time() - sess.start_time)
            h, rem  = divmod(elapsed, 3600)
            m, s    = divmod(rem, 60)
            c["elapsed_lbl"].configure(text="{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d}".format(h, m, s))

        if sess.status in ("done", "stopped"):
            try:
                c["prog"].stop()
                c["prog"].configure(progress_color=COLORS["success"])
                c["prog"].set(1.0)
            except Exception:
                pass
            c["stop_btn"].configure(state="disabled", fg_color=COLORS["border"])

            jd = sess.json_data or {}
            title   = (jd.get("title") or sess.label or "—")[:80]
            creator = jd.get("creator") or jd.get("uploader") or "—"
            c["title_lbl"].configure(text=title)
            c["creator_lbl"].configure(text="👤  {}".format(creator))

        elif sess.status == "recording" and not sess.start_time:
            try:
                c["prog"].start()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _stop_session(self, sid):
        with LIVE_REGISTRY_LOCK:
            sess = LIVE_REGISTRY.get(sid)
        if sess:
            sess.stop()

    def _remove_session(self, sid):
        with LIVE_REGISTRY_LOCK:
            sess = LIVE_REGISTRY.pop(sid, None)
        if sess and sess.status not in ("done", "stopped"):
            sess.stop()
        self.refresh()

    def _poll(self):
        try:
            with LIVE_REGISTRY_LOCK:
                sessions = dict(LIVE_REGISTRY)
            for sid, sess in sessions.items():
                if sid in self._cards:
                    self._update_card(sid, sess)
                else:
                    self._create_card(sid, sess)
                    self._empty_lbl.pack_forget()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.after(1000, self._poll)


# ─── Onglet : Régénérer Vignette & Sprite ────────────────────────────────────

class RegenerateTab(ctk.CTkFrame):
    CELL_W = 320
    CELL_H = 180
    COLS   = 6
    ROWS   = 6

    def __init__(self, master):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self._busy_photo  = False
        self._busy_sprite = False
        self._tk_prev_photo  = None
        self._tk_prev_sprite = None
        self._build()

    def _build(self):
        hdr = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], corner_radius=12)
        hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(20, 10))
        ctk.CTkLabel(hdr, text="Regenerer Vignette & Sprite",
                     font=FONTS["title"], text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(hdr, text="Selectionnez une video, regenerez la vignette et le sprite 6x6.\nLes fichiers existants sont ecrases. Pillow requis pour timecodes.",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
                     justify="left").pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=(0, 14))

        self._picker = FilePicker(
            self, label="FICHIER VIDEO",
            filetypes=[("Video", "*.ts *.mp4 *.mkv *.avi *.mov *.flv *.wmv *.webm"), ("Tous", "*.*")],
            accent=COLORS["accent2"],
        )
        self._picker.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)
        self._picker._path.trace_add("write", self._on_file_selected)

        out_card = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        out_card.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=4)
        out_row = ctk.CTkFrame(out_card, fg_color="transparent")
        out_row.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=8)
        ctk.CTkLabel(out_row, text="Dossier de sortie :",
                     font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(side="left")
        self._out_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(out_row, text="(selectionnez une video)",
                                      font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["accent2"])
        self._out_lbl.pack(side="left", padx=10)

        btn_row = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        btn_row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)
        self._btn_photo = ctk.CTkButton(
            btn_row, text="  Regenerer la vignette",
            font=FONTS["heading"], height=48, corner_radius=12,
            fg_color=COLORS["accent"], hover_color="#3A7AEE",
            command=self._gen_photo,
        )
        self._btn_photo.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 6))
        self._btn_sprite = ctk.CTkButton(
            btn_row, text="  Regenerer le sprite 6x6",
            font=FONTS["heading"], height=48, corner_radius=12,
            fg_color=COLORS["accent2"], hover_color="#8B44EE",
            command=self._gen_sprite,
        )
        self._btn_sprite.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(6, 0))

        self._btn_both = ctk.CTkButton(
            self, text="  Regenerer LES DEUX (vignette + sprite)",
            font=("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"), height=52, corner_radius=12,
            fg_color=COLORS["accent3"], hover_color="#00B890", text_color="#0D0F14",
            command=self._gen_both,
        )
        self._btn_both.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(0, 10))

        prog_card = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        prog_card.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=4)
        for label, attr_p, attr_l, color in [
            ("Vignette", "_prog_photo",  "_lbl_photo",  COLORS["accent"]),
            ("Sprite",   "_prog_sprite", "_lbl_sprite", COLORS["accent2"]),
        ]:
            r = ctk.CTkFrame(prog_card, fg_color="transparent")
            r.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=6)
            ctk.CTkLabel(r, text=label, font=FONTS["body"],
                         text_color=COLORS["muted"], width=70).pack(side="left")
            prog = ctk.CTkProgressBar(r, mode="determinate", progress_color=color, height=8)
            prog.set(0)
            prog.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=8)
            lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(r, text="En attente", font=FONTS["small"],
                                text_color=COLORS["muted"], width=200, anchor="w")
            lbl.pack(side="left")
            setattr(self, attr_p, prog)
            setattr(self, attr_l, lbl)

        prev_card = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        prev_card.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(6, 20))
        ctk.CTkLabel(prev_card, text="APERCU", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 4))
        cols_f = ctk.CTkFrame(prev_card, fg_color="transparent")
        cols_f.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=10, pady=(0, 10))

        col_l = ctk.CTkFrame(cols_f, fg_color=COLORS["border"], corner_radius=8)
        col_l.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, padx=(0, 6))
        ctk.CTkLabel(col_l, text="Vignette aleatoire",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(pady=(8, 4))
        self._prev_photo_lbl = tk.Label(col_l, bg="#2A2F42", bd=0)
        self._prev_photo_lbl.pack(padx=8, pady=(0, 4), fill="both", expand=True)
        self._prev_photo_path = ctk.CTkLabel(col_l, text="", font=FONTS["small"],
                                              text_color=COLORS["muted"], wraplength=300)
        self._prev_photo_path.pack(pady=(0, 8))

        col_r = ctk.CTkFrame(cols_f, fg_color=COLORS["border"], corner_radius=8)
        col_r.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, padx=(6, 0))
        ctk.CTkLabel(col_r, text="Sprite 6x6 (1920x1080)",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(pady=(8, 4))
        self._prev_sprite_lbl = tk.Label(col_r, bg="#2A2F42", bd=0)
        self._prev_sprite_lbl.pack(padx=8, pady=(0, 4), fill="both", expand=True)
        self._prev_sprite_path = ctk.CTkLabel(col_r, text="", font=FONTS["small"],
                                               text_color=COLORS["muted"], wraplength=300)
        self._prev_sprite_path.pack(pady=(0, 8))

    def _on_file_selected(self, *args):
        src = self._picker.path
        if src and os.path.isfile(src):
            out_dir = Path(src).parent / Path(src).stem
            self._out_lbl.configure(text=str(out_dir))
            for name, which in [("snapshot_random.jpg", "photo"), ("sprite_6x6.jpg", "sprite")]:
                p = str(out_dir / name)
                if os.path.isfile(p):
                    self._show_preview(p, which)

    def _get_duration(self, video_path):
        try:
            res = subprocess.run(
                ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
                 "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", video_path],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10,
            )
            return max(2.0, float(res.stdout.strip()))
        except Exception:
            return 60.0

    def _out_dir(self):
        src = self._picker.path
        if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
            return None
        d = Path(src).parent / Path(src).stem
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        return d

    def _set_prog(self, which, value, msg, color=None):
        getattr(self, "_prog_{}".format(which)).set(value)
        getattr(self, "_lbl_{}".format(which)).configure(
            text=msg, text_color=color or COLORS["muted"])

    def _show_preview(self, path, which):
        lbl  = self._prev_photo_lbl  if which == "photo"  else self._prev_sprite_lbl
        plbl = self._prev_photo_path if which == "photo"  else self._prev_sprite_path
        try:
            from PIL import Image as _PI, ImageTk as _ITk
            img = _PI.open(path)
            img.thumbnail((420, 240), _PI.LANCZOS)
            photo = _ITk.PhotoImage(img)
            lbl.configure(image=photo)
            lbl.image = photo
            if which == "photo":
                self._tk_prev_photo = photo
            else:
                self._tk_prev_sprite = photo
        except ImportError:
            lbl.configure(text="Pillow requis - pip install pillow")
        except Exception as e:
            lbl.configure(text="Erreur apercu: {}".format(e))
        plbl.configure(text=os.path.basename(path))

    def _gen_photo(self):
        if self._busy_photo:
            return
        src = self._picker.path
        if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Selectionnez une video.")
            return
        out_dir = self._out_dir()
        if not out_dir:
            return
        self._busy_photo = True
        self._btn_photo.configure(state="disabled", text="  Generation...")
        self._set_prog("photo", 0, "Demarrage...")

        def worker():
            try:
                duration = self._get_duration(src)
                margin   = min(2.0, duration * 0.05)
                rand_t   = random.uniform(margin, duration - margin)
                out_path = str(out_dir / "snapshot_random.jpg")
                tc = "{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d}".format(
                    int(rand_t)//3600, (int(rand_t)%3600)//60, int(rand_t)%60)
                self.after(0, lambda: self._set_prog(
                    "photo", 0.3, "Extraction @ {}...".format(tc)))
                ret = subprocess.run([
                    "ffmpeg", "-y", "-ss", "{:.3f}".format(rand_t), "-i", src,
                    "-frames:v", "1",
                    "-vf", "scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
                           "pad=1280:720:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black",
                    "-q:v", "2", out_path,
                ], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
                if ret.returncode == 0 and os.path.isfile(out_path):
                    sz = os.path.getsize(out_path) // 1024
                    self.after(0, lambda: self._set_prog(
                        "photo", 1.0,
                        "OK  {} Ko  @{}".format(sz, tc),
                        COLORS["success"]))
                    self.after(0, lambda p=out_path: self._show_preview(p, "photo"))
                else:
                    self.after(0, lambda: self._set_prog(
                        "photo", 0, "Echec ffmpeg", COLORS["error"]))
            except Exception as e:
                self.after(0, lambda err=e: self._set_prog(
                    "photo", 0, "Erreur: {}".format(err), COLORS["error"]))
            finally:
                def done():
                    self._busy_photo = False
                    self._btn_photo.configure(state="normal", text="  Regenerer la vignette")
                self.after(0, done)

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    def _gen_sprite(self):
        if self._busy_sprite:
            return
        src = self._picker.path
        if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Selectionnez une video.")
            return
        out_dir = self._out_dir()
        if not out_dir:
            return
        self._busy_sprite = True
        self._btn_sprite.configure(state="disabled", text="  Generation...")
        self._set_prog("sprite", 0, "Demarrage...")

        CW, CH, COLS, ROWS = self.CELL_W, self.CELL_H, self.COLS, self.ROWS
        total = COLS * ROWS

        def worker():
            import tempfile as _tf, shutil as _sh
            tmp_dir = None
            try:
                tmp_dir  = _tf.mkdtemp(prefix="sprite_regen_")
                out_path = str(out_dir / "sprite_6x6.jpg")
                duration = self._get_duration(src)
                step     = duration / total
                timestamps = [step * (i + 0.5) for i in range(total)]
                frame_paths = []
                last_good   = None

                for i, ts in enumerate(timestamps):
                    self.after(0, lambda p=i/total, idx=i: self._set_prog(
                        "sprite", p, "Frame {}/{}...".format(idx + 1, total)))
                    fp = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "f_{:02d}.jpg".format(i))
                    ret = subprocess.run([
                        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-ss", "{:.6f}".format(ts), "-i", src,
                        "-frames:v", "1",
                        "-vf", "scale={w}:{h}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
                               "pad={w}:{h}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=black".format(w=CW, h=CH),
                        "-q:v", "2", fp,
                    ], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
                    if ret.returncode == 0 and os.path.isfile(fp):
                        last_good = fp
                        frame_paths.append(fp)
                    elif last_good:
                        _sh.copy2(last_good, fp)
                        frame_paths.append(fp)
                    else:
                        frame_paths.append(None)

                self.after(0, lambda: self._set_prog("sprite", 0.95, "Assemblage..."))

                try:
                    from PIL import Image as _PI, ImageDraw as _PID
                    sprite = _PI.new("RGB", (CW * COLS, CH * ROWS), (10, 10, 20))
                    draw   = _PID.Draw(sprite)
                    for idx, fp in enumerate(frame_paths):
                        col = idx % COLS
                        row = idx // COLS
                        ts  = timestamps[idx]
                        x0, y0 = col * CW, row * CH
                        if fp and os.path.isfile(fp):
                            try:
                                cell = _PI.open(fp).resize((CW, CH), _PI.LANCZOS)
                                sprite.paste(cell, (x0, y0))
                            except Exception:
                                pass
                        tc = "{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d}".format(
                            int(ts//3600), int((ts%3600)//60), int(ts%60))
                        tx, ty = x0 + 5, y0 + CH - 22
                        draw.text((tx+1, ty+1), tc, fill=(0, 0, 0))
                        draw.text((tx,   ty  ), tc, fill=(0, 255, 120))
                    sprite.save(out_path, "JPEG", quality=88)
                    method = "Pillow"
                except ImportError:
                    pattern = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "f_%02d.jpg")
                    subprocess.run([
                        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", pattern,
                        "-frames:v", "1",
                        "-vf", "tile={}x{}".format(COLS, ROWS),
                        "-q:v", "2", out_path,
                    ], capture_output=True)
                    method = "ffmpeg (sans timecodes)"

                if os.path.isfile(out_path):
                    sz = os.path.getsize(out_path) // 1024
                    self.after(0, lambda: self._set_prog(
                        "sprite", 1.0,
                        "OK  {} Ko  step={:.1f}s  {}".format(sz, step, method),
                        COLORS["success"]))
                    self.after(0, lambda p=out_path: self._show_preview(p, "sprite"))
                else:
                    self.after(0, lambda: self._set_prog(
                        "sprite", 0, "Assemblage echoue", COLORS["error"]))
            except Exception as e:
                self.after(0, lambda err=e: self._set_prog(
                    "sprite", 0, "Erreur: {}".format(err), COLORS["error"]))
            finally:
                if tmp_dir:
                    import shutil as _sh2
                    _sh2.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
                def done():
                    self._busy_sprite = False
                    self._btn_sprite.configure(state="normal", text="  Regenerer le sprite 6x6")
                self.after(0, done)

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    def _gen_both(self):
        src = self._picker.path
        if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Selectionnez une video.")
            return
        self._gen_photo()
        self._gen_sprite()


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PUBLISH TAB — Publication Doodstream + API TikCapture
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

TIKCAPTURE_API = "https://tikcapture.live/segment_page/api/pub_model_video.php"


def _day_folder() -> str:
    """Retourne le dossier du jour au format JJ_MM_AAAA."""
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%d_%m_%Y")


def _multipart_body(fields: dict, files: dict):
    """
    Construit un corps multipart/form-data.
    fields : {name: value_str}
    files  : {name: filepath_str}  — les fichiers sont lus depuis le disque.
    Retourne (body_bytes, boundary_str).
    """
    boundary = "MPBoundary" + os.urandom(10).hex()
    parts = []

    for name, value in fields.items():
        parts.append(
            f"--{boundary}\r\n"
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"\r\n\r\n'
            f"{value}\r\n"
        )

    for name, filepath in files.items():
        if not filepath or not os.path.isfile(filepath):
            continue
        filename = Path(filepath).name
        ext = Path(filepath).suffix.lower()
        ctype = "video/mp4" if ext in (".mp4", ".ts", ".mkv") else "image/jpeg"
        header = (
            f"--{boundary}\r\n"
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"; filename="{filename}"\r\n'
            f"Content-Type: {ctype}\r\n\r\n"
        )
        with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
            data = f.read()
        parts.append(header.encode() + data + b"\r\n")

    body = b"".join(
        (p.encode() if isinstance(p, str) else p) for p in parts
    ) + f"--{boundary}--\r\n".encode()

    return body, boundary


def _find_profil_pic(rec_dir: Path):
    """Retourne le nom de fichier de la photo de profil si elle existe."""
    for ext in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"):
        p = rec_dir / "profil_pic{}".format(ext)
        if p.is_file():
            return "profil_pic{}".format(ext)
    return None


class PublishTab(ctk.CTkFrame):
    """
    Onglet de publication :
      1. Liste les dossiers d'enregistrements dans lives/
      2. Pour chaque enregistrement : affiche vignette, sprite, démo
      3. Bouton Publier :
         a. Upload la vidéo principale sur Doodstream  → filecode + embed
         b. Appel API TikCapture (pub_model_video.php) avec multipart :
            - Fichiers : thumbnail, cover, sprite, demo
            - Métadonnées : username, display_name, signature, title, description, etc.
    """

    def __init__(self, master):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self._busy      = False
        self._sessions  = []   # liste des dicts de sessions détectées
        self._api_key   = tk.StringVar(value="116859tc0vf080ijf3jk5x")
        self._build()
        self.after(300, self._scan_recordings)

    # ─── Construction UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _build(self):
        # ── En-tête ──
        hdr = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], corner_radius=12)
        hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(20, 10))

        title_row = ctk.CTkFrame(hdr, fg_color="transparent")
        title_row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(title_row, text="🚀  Publier sur Doodstream",
                     font=FONTS["title"], text_color=COLORS["accent3"]).pack(side="left")
        if not DOOD_AVAILABLE:
            badge = ctk.CTkFrame(title_row, fg_color=COLORS["error"], corner_radius=20)
            badge.pack(side="left", padx=14)
            ctk.CTkLabel(badge, text="doodstream_api.py introuvable",
                         font=FONTS["small"], text_color="white").pack(padx=10, pady=4)

        ctk.CTkLabel(
            hdr,
            text=(
                "Scanne les enregistrements dans lives/  •  "
                "Upload sur Doodstream  •  "
                "Enregistre dans la BD via TikCapture API"
            ),
            font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
        ).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=(0, 14))

        # ── Clé API + dossier ──
        cfg = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        cfg.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=4)
        cfg_row = ctk.CTkFrame(cfg, fg_color="transparent")
        cfg_row.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=10)

        # Clé Doodstream
        c1 = ctk.CTkFrame(cfg_row, fg_color="transparent")
        c1.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 8))
        ctk.CTkLabel(c1, text="Clé API Doodstream", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        ctk.CTkEntry(c1, textvariable=self._api_key, font=FONTS["body"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        # Dossier lives
        c2 = ctk.CTkFrame(cfg_row, fg_color="transparent")
        c2.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c2, text="Dossier lives/", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        dir_row = ctk.CTkFrame(c2, fg_color="transparent")
        dir_row.pack(fill="x")
        self._lives_dir = tk.StringVar(value=str(SCRIPT_DIR / "lives"))
        ctk.CTkEntry(dir_row, textvariable=self._lives_dir, font=FONTS["small"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 4))
        ctk.CTkButton(dir_row, text="📁", width=36, height=30,
                      fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
                      command=self._pick_lives_dir).pack(side="right")

        # ── Bouton scan ──
        scan_row = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        scan_row.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)
        ctk.CTkButton(
            scan_row, text="🔍  Scanner les enregistrements",
            font=FONTS["heading"], height=44, corner_radius=12,
            fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
            command=self._scan_recordings,
        ).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 8))
        self._count_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
            scan_row, text="", font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]
        )
        self._count_lbl.pack(side="left")

        # ── Liste scrollable des enregistrements ──
        ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="ENREGISTREMENTS DISPONIBLES",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=24)

        self._scroll = ctk.CTkScrollableFrame(self, fg_color="transparent", corner_radius=0)
        self._scroll.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(4, 0))

        self._empty_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
            self._scroll,
            text="Aucun enregistrement trouvé.\nLancez d'abord un enregistrement dans 🔴 Live Recorder.",
            font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["muted"], justify="center",
        )
        self._empty_lbl.pack(pady=40)

        # ── Log global ──
        ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="JOURNAL DE PUBLICATION",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=24, pady=(8, 0))
        self._log = LogBox(self)
        self._log.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(4, 20), ipady=4)
        self._log._text.configure(height=6)

    # ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _pick_lives_dir(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory()
        if d:
            self._lives_dir.set(d)

    def _log_msg(self, msg):
        self.after(0, lambda m=msg: self._log.append(m))

    # ─── Scan des enregistrements ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _scan_recordings(self):
        """
        Parcourt lives/ et cherche les sous-dossiers contenant :
          - un fichier .ts (vidéo principale)
          - snapshot_random.jpg (vignette)
          - sprite_6x6.jpg (sprite)
          - info.json (métadonnées yt-dlp)
        """
        lives_root = Path(self._lives_dir.get())
        sessions   = []

        if lives_root.is_dir():
            for rec_dir in sorted(lives_root.iterdir(), reverse=True):
                if not rec_dir.is_dir():
                    continue

                # Chercher le .ts
                ts_files = list(rec_dir.glob("*.ts"))
                if not ts_files:
                    ts_files = list(rec_dir.glob("*.mp4"))
                if not ts_files:
                    continue
                ts_file = ts_files[0]

                # Métadonnées yt-dlp
                info_json = rec_dir / "info.json"
                info = {}
                if info_json.is_file():
                    try:
                        import json as _json
                        info = _json.loads(info_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    except Exception:
                        pass

                thumb  = rec_dir / "snapshot_random.jpg"
                sprite = rec_dir / "sprite_6x6.jpg"

                # Chercher une démo mp4 éventuelle
                demo = None
                for mp4 in rec_dir.glob("*.mp4"):
                    demo = mp4
                    break

                sessions.append({
                    "rec_dir":     rec_dir,
                    "ts_file":     ts_file,
                    "thumb":       thumb   if thumb.is_file()  else None,
                    "sprite":      sprite  if sprite.is_file() else None,
                    "demo":        demo,
                    "info":        info,
                    "title":       info.get("title", rec_dir.name),
                    "uploader":    info.get("uploader", ""),
                    "description": info.get("description", ""),
                    "published":   False,
                })

        self._sessions = sessions
        self._count_lbl.configure(
            text="{} enregistrement(s) trouvé(s)".format(len(sessions))
        )
        self._rebuild_list()

    def _rebuild_list(self):
        """Reconstruit la liste des cartes dans le scroll."""
        for widget in self._scroll.winfo_children():
            widget.destroy()

        if not self._sessions:
            self._empty_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(
                self._scroll,
                text="Aucun enregistrement trouvé.\nLancez d'abord un enregistrement dans 🔴 Live Recorder.",
                font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["muted"], justify="center",
            )
            self._empty_lbl.pack(pady=40)
            return

        for idx, sess in enumerate(self._sessions):
            self._create_rec_card(idx, sess)

    def _create_rec_card(self, idx: int, sess: dict):
        """Crée une carte pour un enregistrement."""
        card = ctk.CTkFrame(
            self._scroll, fg_color=COLORS["card"],
            corner_radius=12, border_width=1, border_color=COLORS["border"],
        )
        card.pack(fill="x", pady=6, padx=4)

        body = ctk.CTkFrame(card, fg_color="transparent")
        body.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=12)

        # ── Colonne gauche : miniature ──
        thumb_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(body, fg_color=COLORS["border"],
                                   corner_radius=8, width=120, height=90)
        thumb_frame.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 14))
        thumb_frame.pack_propagate(False)

        if sess["thumb"]:
            try:
                from PIL import Image as _PI, ImageTk as _ITk
                img = _PI.open(str(sess["thumb"]))
                img.thumbnail((120, 90), _PI.LANCZOS)
                photo = _ITk.PhotoImage(img)
                lbl = tk.Label(thumb_frame, image=photo, bg="#2A2F42", bd=0)
                lbl.image = photo
                lbl.place(x=0, y=0, width=120, height=90)
            except Exception:
                ctk.CTkLabel(thumb_frame, text="🖼", font=("Segoe UI", 28),
                             text_color=COLORS["muted"]).place(relx=.5, rely=.5, anchor="center")
        else:
            ctk.CTkLabel(thumb_frame, text="🎬\nPas de\nvignette",
                         font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
                         justify="center").place(relx=.5, rely=.5, anchor="center")

        # ── Colonne droite : infos + champs éditables ──
        info_col = ctk.CTkFrame(body, fg_color="transparent")
        info_col.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)

        # Titre et uploader
        top_row = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        top_row.pack(fill="x")
        ctk.CTkLabel(top_row,
                     text="👤 {}".format(sess["uploader"] or "Inconnu"),
                     font=FONTS["heading"], text_color=COLORS["accent2"]).pack(side="left")

        # Statut fichiers
        files_row = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        files_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(2, 4))
        for label, exists in [
            ("📹 TS",      sess["ts_file"] and sess["ts_file"].is_file()),
            ("🖼 Vignette", bool(sess["thumb"])),
            ("🔲 Sprite",   bool(sess["sprite"])),
            ("🎞 Démo",     bool(sess["demo"])),
        ]:
            color = COLORS["success"] if exists else COLORS["error"]
            ctk.CTkLabel(files_row, text=label, font=FONTS["small"],
                         text_color=color).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 10))

        # ── Champs éditables dans une grille ──
        fields_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        fields_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        # Ligne 1 : username | display_name
        row1 = ctk.CTkFrame(fields_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        row1.pack(fill="x", pady=2)

        username_var = tk.StringVar(value=sess.get("uploader", ""))
        display_var  = tk.StringVar(value=sess["info"].get("uploader", ""))
        title_var    = tk.StringVar(value=sess["title"])
        sig_var      = tk.StringVar(value=sess["info"].get("description", "")[:100])
        desc_var     = tk.StringVar(value=sess.get("description", ""))

        for col_frame, label, var in [
            (row1, "Username (@)", username_var),
            (row1, "Nom affiché",  display_var),
        ]:
            c = ctk.CTkFrame(col_frame, fg_color="transparent")
            c.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 6))
            ctk.CTkLabel(c, text=label, font=FONTS["small"],
                         text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
            ctk.CTkEntry(c, textvariable=var, font=FONTS["small"],
                         fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                         text_color=COLORS["text"], height=30).pack(fill="x")

        # Ligne 2 : titre | signature
        row2 = ctk.CTkFrame(fields_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        row2.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        for col_frame, label, var in [
            (row2, "Titre du live",   title_var),
