            (row2, "Signature (bio)", sig_var),
        ]:
            c = ctk.CTkFrame(col_frame, fg_color="transparent")
            c.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 6))
            ctk.CTkLabel(c, text=label, font=FONTS["small"],
                         text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
            ctk.CTkEntry(c, textvariable=var, font=FONTS["small"],
                         fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                         text_color=COLORS["text"], height=30).pack(fill="x")

        # Sélecteur de démo manuelle
        demo_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(sess["demo"]) if sess["demo"] else "")
        demo_row = ctk.CTkFrame(fields_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        demo_row.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        ctk.CTkLabel(demo_row, text="Fichier démo (mp4) :",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(side="left")
        ctk.CTkEntry(demo_row, textvariable=demo_var, font=FONTS["small"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"], height=28,
                     width=300).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        ctk.CTkButton(
            demo_row, text="📁", width=30, height=28,
            fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
            command=lambda v=demo_var: v.set(
                filedialog.askopenfilename(
                    filetypes=[("Vidéo", "*.mp4 *.ts *.mkv"), ("Tous", "*.*")]
                ) or v.get()
            ),
        ).pack(side="left")

        # ── Barre de progression + statut de cette carte ──
        prog_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(info_col, fg_color="transparent")
        prog_frame.pack(fill="x", pady=(4, 0))
        prog = ctk.CTkProgressBar(prog_frame, mode="determinate",
                                   progress_color=COLORS["accent3"], height=6)
        prog.set(0)
        prog.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 8))
        status_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(prog_frame, text="En attente",
                                   font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
                                   width=180, anchor="w")
        status_lbl.pack(side="left")

        # ── Bouton Publier ──
        pub_btn = ctk.CTkButton(
            card,
            text="🚀  Publier",
            font=FONTS["heading"], height=40, corner_radius=10,
            fg_color=COLORS["accent3"], hover_color="#00B890", text_color="#0D0F14",
            command=lambda i=idx, uv=username_var, dv=display_var, tv=title_var,
                           sv=sig_var, dscv=desc_var, demv=demo_var,
                           p=prog, sl=status_lbl, btn_ref=None: self._publish(
                i, uv, dv, tv, sv, dscv, demv, p, sl
            ),
        )
        pub_btn.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=(0, 12))

    # ─── Pipeline de publication ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _publish(self, idx, username_var, display_var, title_var,
                 sig_var, desc_var, demo_var,
                 prog, status_lbl):
        """Lance le pipeline de publication dans un thread."""
        if self._busy:
            messagebox.showwarning("Occupation", "Une publication est déjà en cours.")
            return

        sess = self._sessions[idx]

        username     = username_var.get().strip().lstrip("@")
        display_name = display_var.get().strip()
        title        = title_var.get().strip()
        signature    = sig_var.get().strip()
        description  = desc_var.get().strip()
        demo_path    = demo_var.get().strip() or None
        api_key      = self._api_key.get().strip()

        if not username:
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Le champ Username est obligatoire.")
            return
        if not api_key:
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "La clé API Doodstream est vide.")
            return

        self._busy = True

        def _set_status(msg, p_val=None):
            self.after(0, lambda m=msg: status_lbl.configure(text=m))
            if p_val is not None:
                self.after(0, lambda v=p_val: prog.set(v))
            self._log_msg(msg)

        def worker():
            try:
                # ── Étape 1 : Cover via yt-dlp ───────────────────────────────
                _set_status("1/4 Récupération cover TikTok…", 0.05)
                cover_path = self._fetch_cover(sess, username)

                # ── Étape 2 : Conversion si besoin + Upload Doodstream ───────
                _set_status("2/4 Conv. + Upload Doodstream…", 0.15)
                dood_code, dood_embed = self._upload_doodstream(
                    sess, api_key, title,
                    lambda sent, total: self.after(0, lambda s=sent, t=total:
                        prog.set(0.15 + 0.55 * (s / t if t else 0)))
                )

                # ── Étape 3 : Génération démo 15s ────────────────────────────
                _set_status("3/4 Génération vidéo démo 15s…", 0.70)

                demo_generated = None
                try:
                    demo_out = sess["rec_dir"] / "demo_15s.mp4"
                    dur = self._get_duration(str(sess["ts_file"]))
                    # Prendre un extrait au 1/4 de la vidéo
                    start = max(0, int(dur * 0.25))
                    cmd_demo = [
                        "ffmpeg", "-y",
                        "-ss", str(start),
                        "-i", str(sess["ts_file"]),
                        "-t", "15",
                        "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "23", "-preset", "fast",
                        "-c:a", "aac",
                        "-movflags", "+faststart",
                        str(demo_out),
                    ]
                    ret_demo = subprocess.run(cmd_demo, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
                    if ret_demo.returncode == 0 and demo_out.is_file():
                        demo_generated = demo_out
                        self._log_msg("  ✅ Démo générée : {}".format(demo_out.name))
                    else:
                        self._log_msg("  ⚠ Démo échouée")
                except Exception as e:
                    self._log_msg("  ⚠ Démo erreur : {}".format(e))

                # ── Étape 4 : Sauvegarde JSON local ──────────────────────────
                _set_status("4/4 Sauvegarde JSON…", 0.85)

                import json as _json

                rec_dir = sess["rec_dir"]

                def _rel(abs_path):
                    """Retourne le chemin relatif par rapport au rec_dir."""
                    if not abs_path:
                        return None
                    try:
                        return Path(abs_path).relative_to(rec_dir).as_posix()
                    except ValueError:
                        return Path(abs_path).name

                # ── Suppression du sous-dossier doublon ──────────────────────
                # Ex: rec_dir = lives/doaa.715_xxx/
                #     doublon  = lives/doaa.715_xxx/doaa.715_xxx/  ← supprimé
                try:
                    duplicate_dir = rec_dir / rec_dir.name
                    if duplicate_dir.is_dir():
                        shutil.rmtree(str(duplicate_dir))
                        self._log_msg("  🗑 Dossier doublon supprimé : {}".format(duplicate_dir.name))
                except Exception as e:
                    self._log_msg("  ⚠ Suppression doublon : {}".format(e))

                published_data = {
                    "published_at":     datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                    "day_folder":       _day_folder(),
                    "username":         username,
                    "display_name":     display_name,
                    "signature":        signature,
                    "title":            title,
                    "description":      description,
                    "duration":         self._get_duration(str(sess["ts_file"])),
                    "recorded_at":      sess["info"].get("release_timestamp", ""),
                    "doodstream_code":  dood_code  or "",
                    "doodstream_embed": dood_embed or "",
                    "thumbnail":        _rel(sess["thumb"]),
                    "cover":            _rel(cover_path),
                    "profil_pic":       _find_profil_pic(sess["rec_dir"]),
                    "sprite":           _rel(sess["sprite"]),
                    "demo":             _rel(demo_generated or demo_path),
                    "transcript_txt":   "transcript.txt",
                    "transcript_srt":   "transcript.srt",
                    "transcript_json":  "transcript.json",
                    "source_ts":        _rel(sess["ts_file"]),
                    "yt_dlp_info": {
                        "webpage_url":  sess["info"].get("webpage_url",  ""),
                        "uploader":     sess["info"].get("uploader",     ""),
                        "uploader_id":  sess["info"].get("uploader_id",  ""),
                        "uploader_url": sess["info"].get("uploader_url", ""),
                        "view_count":   sess["info"].get("view_count",   0),
                        "like_count":   sess["info"].get("like_count",   0),
                    },
                }

                json_out = rec_dir / "published.json"
                try:
                    json_out.write_text(
                        _json.dumps(published_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                        encoding="utf-8"
                    )
                    _set_status("✅ Publié !", 1.0)
                    self.after(0, lambda: prog.configure(progress_color=COLORS["success"]))
                    sess["published"] = True
                    self._log_msg("  📄 Fichier : {}".format(json_out.name))
                    self._log_msg("  🔗 Embed   : {}".format(dood_embed))
                except Exception as e:
                    _set_status("❌ Erreur JSON : {}".format(e), 1.0)
                    self.after(0, lambda: prog.configure(progress_color=COLORS["error"]))

            except Exception as e:
                _set_status("❌ Erreur : {}".format(e), 1.0)
                self.after(0, lambda: prog.configure(progress_color=COLORS["error"]))
            finally:
                self._busy = False

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    # ─── Sous-méthodes pipeline ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _fetch_cover(self, sess: dict, username: str):
        """
        Essaie de récupérer la photo de couverture TikTok via yt-dlp.
        Retourne le chemin local du fichier téléchargé, ou None.
        """
        url = sess["info"].get("webpage_url") or sess["info"].get("original_url") or ""
        if not url:
            # Construire l'URL du profil à partir du username
            url = "https://www.tiktok.com/@{}".format(username)

        tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cover_")
        out_tpl = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "cover")
        try:
            ret = subprocess.run(
                ["yt-dlp", "--write-thumbnail", "--skip-download",
                 "-o", out_tpl, url],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
            )
            # Chercher le fichier téléchargé
            for f in Path(tmp_dir).iterdir():
                if f.is_file() and f.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"):
                    # Copier dans le dossier de l'enregistrement pour réutilisation
                    dest = sess["rec_dir"] / ("cover" + f.suffix)
                    shutil.copy2(str(f), str(dest))
                    self._log_msg("  Cover récupérée : {}".format(dest))
                    return str(dest)
        except Exception as e:
            self._log_msg("  ⚠ Cover non récupérée : {}".format(e))
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
        return None

    def _upload_doodstream(self, sess, api_key, title, on_progress=None):
        """
        Upload la vidéo sur Doodstream.
        Si le fichier source n'est pas MP4, il est converti automatiquement
        via FFmpeg dans un fichier temporaire avant l'upload.
        Retourne (filecode, embed_url).
        """
        if not DOOD_AVAILABLE:
            self._log_msg("  ⚠ doodstream_api.py non disponible — upload ignoré")
            return "", ""

        src_path   = Path(str(sess["ts_file"]))
        upload_path = str(src_path)
        tmp_mp4    = None   # fichier converti à supprimer après upload

        # ── Conversion si pas MP4 ──────────────────────────────────────────
        if src_path.suffix.lower() != ".mp4":
            self._log_msg("  🔄 Source non-MP4 ({}) → conversion en MP4 avant upload…".format(
                src_path.suffix))
            tmp_dir  = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dood_conv_")
            tmp_mp4  = os.path.join(tmp_dir, src_path.stem + "_dood.mp4")

            cmd = [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                "-i", str(src_path),
                "-c:v", "copy",
                "-c:a", "aac",
                "-movflags", "+faststart",
                tmp_mp4,
            ]
            self._log_msg("  ▶ {}".format(" ".join(cmd)))
            ret = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                 encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            if ret.returncode != 0 or not os.path.isfile(tmp_mp4):
                self._log_msg("  ❌ Conversion échouée :\n{}".format(ret.stderr[-300:]))
                if tmp_mp4:
                    shutil.rmtree(os.path.dirname(tmp_mp4), ignore_errors=True)
                return "", ""

            size_mb = os.path.getsize(tmp_mp4) / (1024 * 1024)
            self._log_msg("  ✅ Conversion OK → {} ({:.1f} Mo)".format(
                os.path.basename(tmp_mp4), size_mb))
            upload_path = tmp_mp4
        else:
            self._log_msg("  ✅ Source déjà MP4, upload direct")

        # ── Upload ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        try:
            api = _get_dood_api(api_key)
            self._log_msg("  📤 Upload Doodstream : {}".format(os.path.basename(upload_path)))

            result = api.upload_file(upload_path, title=title, on_progress=on_progress)
            self._log_msg("  Réponse Doodstream : {}".format(result))

            if result.get("status") == 200:
                try:
                    file_info = result["result"][0]
                    code  = file_info.get("filecode", "")
                    embed = "https://dood.li/e/{}".format(code)
                    self._log_msg("  ✅ Doodstream filecode : {}".format(code))
                    return code, embed
                except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as e:
                    self._log_msg("  ⚠ Parsing réponse Doodstream : {}".format(e))
            else:
                self._log_msg("  ❌ Doodstream erreur : {}".format(result.get("msg", "")))

        finally:
            # Supprimer le MP4 temporaire dans tous les cas
            if tmp_mp4 and os.path.isfile(tmp_mp4):
                try:
                    shutil.rmtree(os.path.dirname(tmp_mp4), ignore_errors=True)
                    self._log_msg("  🗑 Fichier MP4 temporaire supprimé")
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return "", ""

    def _call_tikcapture(self, fields: dict, files: dict) -> dict:
        """Envoie un POST multipart à l'API TikCapture."""
        import json as _json
        body, boundary = _multipart_body(fields, files)
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            TIKCAPTURE_API, data=body, method="POST"
        )
        req.add_header("Content-Type", f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}")
        req.add_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        req.add_header("User-Agent", "MediaForge/1.0")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300) as resp:
                raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
                self._log_msg("  API TikCapture réponse : {}".format(raw[:200]))
                return _json.loads(raw)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            try:
                body_err = e.read().decode("utf-8")
            except Exception:
                body_err = str(e)
            self._log_msg("  ❌ HTTP {} : {}".format(e.code, body_err[:200]))
            return {"status": e.code, "msg": body_err}
        except Exception as e:
            self._log_msg("  ❌ Réseau : {}".format(e))
            return {"status": 0, "msg": str(e)}

    def _get_duration(self, video_path: str) -> int:
        """Retourne la durée en secondes via ffprobe, ou 0."""
        try:
            import json as _json
            res = subprocess.run(
                ["ffprobe", "-v", "quiet", "-print_format", "json",
                 "-show_format", video_path],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15,
            )
            data = _json.loads(res.stdout)
            return int(float(data.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0)))
        except Exception:
            return 0


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSCRIPT TAB — Extraction de transcript via Whisper
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TranscriptTab(ctk.CTkFrame):
    WHISPER_MODELS = ["tiny", "base", "small", "medium", "large", "large-v2", "large-v3"]

    def __init__(self, master):
        super().__init__(master, fg_color="transparent")
        self._busy = False
        self._build()

    def _build(self):
        # ── En-tête ──
        hdr = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], corner_radius=12)
        hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(20, 10))
        ctk.CTkLabel(hdr, text="🎙  Extraction Transcript",
                     font=FONTS["title"], text_color=COLORS["text"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(
            hdr,
            text=(
                "Extrait le transcript audio d'une vidéo via Whisper (OpenAI).\n"
                "Résultat sauvegardé dans le dossier de la vidéo : transcript.txt / .srt / .json\n"
                "Prérequis : pip install openai-whisper  •  ffmpeg dans PATH"
            ),
            font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"], justify="left",
        ).pack(anchor="w", padx=20, pady=(0, 14))

        # ── Sélecteur de fichier ──
        self._picker = FilePicker(
            self, label="FICHIER VIDÉO / AUDIO",
            filetypes=[
                ("Vidéo / Audio", "*.ts *.mp4 *.mkv *.avi *.mov *.flv *.wmv *.webm *.mp3 *.wav *.m4a *.aac"),
                ("Tous", "*.*"),
            ],
            accent=COLORS["accent2"],
        )
        self._picker.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)

        # ── Options ──
        opts = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        opts.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=6)
        ctk.CTkLabel(opts, text="OPTIONS WHISPER", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 4))

        row = ctk.CTkFrame(opts, fg_color="transparent")
        row.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 12))

        # Modèle
        c1 = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
        c1.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c1, text="Modèle", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        ctk.CTkLabel(c1,
                     text="tiny=rapide/imprécis  →  large-v3=lent/précis",
                     font=("Segoe UI", 9), text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        self._model_var = tk.StringVar(value="small")
        model_menu = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(
            c1, values=self.WHISPER_MODELS,
            variable=self._model_var,
            font=FONTS["body"], fg_color=COLORS["border"],
            button_color=COLORS["accent2"],
            dropdown_fg_color=COLORS["card"],
        )
        model_menu.pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        # Langue
        c2 = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
        c2.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c2, text="Langue (optionnel)", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        ctk.CTkLabel(c2, text="ex: fr, en, ar — vide = détection auto",
                     font=("Segoe UI", 9), text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        self._lang_var = tk.StringVar(value="")
        ctk.CTkEntry(c2, textvariable=self._lang_var, font=FONTS["body"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"],
                     placeholder_text="auto").pack(fill="x", pady=4)

        # Formats de sortie
        c3 = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
        c3.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c3, text="Formats de sortie", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        ctk.CTkLabel(c3, text=" ", font=("Segoe UI", 9),
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        fmt_row = ctk.CTkFrame(c3, fg_color="transparent")
        fmt_row.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        self._fmt_txt  = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self._fmt_srt  = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self._fmt_json = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        for label, var in [("TXT", self._fmt_txt), ("SRT", self._fmt_srt), ("JSON", self._fmt_json)]:
            ctk.CTkCheckBox(
                fmt_row, text=label, variable=var,
                font=FONTS["body"], text_color=COLORS["text"],
                fg_color=COLORS["accent2"], hover_color=COLORS["accent"],
                checkmark_color="white",
            ).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 12))

        # Dossier de sortie
        c4 = ctk.CTkFrame(row, fg_color="transparent")
        c4.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=4)
        ctk.CTkLabel(c4, text="Dossier de sortie", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        ctk.CTkLabel(c4, text="vide = dossier de la vidéo",
                     font=("Segoe UI", 9), text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w")
        out_row = ctk.CTkFrame(c4, fg_color="transparent")
        out_row.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        self._out_var = tk.StringVar(value="")
        ctk.CTkEntry(out_row, textvariable=self._out_var, font=FONTS["small"],
                     fg_color=COLORS["border"], border_color=COLORS["border"],
                     text_color=COLORS["text"],
                     placeholder_text="auto").pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 4))
        ctk.CTkButton(out_row, text="📁", width=36, height=30,
                      fg_color=COLORS["border"], hover_color=COLORS["card"],
                      command=self._pick_out_dir).pack(side="right")

        # ── Bouton lancer ──
        self._btn = ctk.CTkButton(
            self, text="  🎙  Lancer la transcription",
            font=("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"), height=52, corner_radius=12,
            fg_color=COLORS["accent2"], hover_color="#8B44EE",
            command=self._run,
        )
        self._btn.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=10)

        # ── Barre de progression ──
        prog_card = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        prog_card.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(0, 6))
        prog_row = ctk.CTkFrame(prog_card, fg_color="transparent")
        prog_row.pack(fill="x", padx=14, pady=8)
        self._prog = ctk.CTkProgressBar(prog_row, mode="indeterminate",
                                         progress_color=COLORS["accent2"], height=8)
        self._prog.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=(0, 10))
        self._prog_lbl = ctk.CTkLabel(prog_row, text="En attente",
                                       font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"],
                                       width=220, anchor="w")
        self._prog_lbl.pack(side="left")

        # ── Aperçu du transcript ──
        prev_card = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=10)
        prev_card.pack(fill="x", padx=20, pady=(0, 6))
        ctk.CTkLabel(prev_card, text="APERÇU TRANSCRIPT",
                     font=FONTS["small"], text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=14, pady=(8, 2))
        self._preview = ctk.CTkTextbox(
            prev_card, font=FONTS["mono"], height=120,
            fg_color=COLORS["border"], text_color=COLORS["text"],
            wrap="word", activate_scrollbars=True,
        )
        self._preview.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(0, 10))
        self._preview.configure(state="disabled")

        # ── Log ──
        ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="JOURNAL", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(anchor="w", padx=24)
        self._log = LogBox(self)
        self._log.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(4, 20))

    def _pick_out_dir(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory()
        if d:
            self._out_var.set(d)

    def _set_status(self, msg, color=None):
        self._prog_lbl.configure(text=msg, text_color=color or COLORS["muted"])
        self._log.append(msg)

    def _set_preview(self, text):
        self._preview.configure(state="normal")
        self._preview.delete("1.0", "end")
        self._preview.insert("1.0", text[:3000])
        self._preview.configure(state="disabled")

    def _run(self):
        if self._busy:
            return

        src = self._picker.path
        if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Veuillez sélectionner un fichier vidéo ou audio.")
            return

        model    = self._model_var.get()
        lang     = self._lang_var.get().strip() or None
        fmt_txt  = self._fmt_txt.get()
        fmt_srt  = self._fmt_srt.get()
        fmt_json = self._fmt_json.get()

        if not fmt_txt and not fmt_srt and not fmt_json:
            messagebox.showerror("Erreur", "Cochez au moins un format de sortie.")
            return

        # Dossier de sortie
        out_dir_str = self._out_var.get().strip()
        out_dir = Path(out_dir_str) if out_dir_str else Path(src).parent

        self._busy = True
        self._btn.configure(state="disabled", text="  Transcription en cours…")
        self._prog.start()
        self._log.clear()
        self._set_status("Chargement modèle Whisper '{}'…".format(model))

        def worker():
            try:
                import whisper as _whisper
            except ImportError:
                self.after(0, lambda: self._finish(False,
                    "❌ Whisper non installé.\nLancez : pip install openai-whisper"))
                return

            try:
                self.after(0, lambda: self._set_status(
                    "Chargement modèle '{}'…".format(model)))
                model_obj = _whisper.load_model(model)

                self.after(0, lambda: self._set_status(
                    "Transcription en cours (peut prendre plusieurs minutes)…"))

                options = {}
                if lang:
                    options["language"] = lang

                result = model_obj.transcribe(src, **options)

                detected_lang = result.get("language", "?")
                segments      = result.get("segments", [])
                full_text     = result.get("text", "").strip()

                self.after(0, lambda t=full_text: self._set_preview(t))
                self.after(0, lambda: self._set_status(
                    "Langue détectée : {}  |  {} segments".format(
                        detected_lang, len(segments))))

                stem = Path(src).stem
                saved = []

                # ── TXT ──
                if fmt_txt:
                    txt_lines = []
                    for seg in segments:
                        t_start = seg["start"]
                        t_end   = seg["end"]
                        text    = seg["text"].strip()
                        tc_start = _fmt_srt_time(t_start).replace(",", ".")
                        tc_end   = _fmt_srt_time(t_end).replace(",", ".")
                        txt_lines.append("[{}  →  {}]  {}".format(
                            tc_start, tc_end, text))
                    txt_path = out_dir / "transcript.txt"
                    txt_path.write_text(
                        "\n".join(txt_lines), encoding="utf-8")
                    saved.append(str(txt_path))

                # ── SRT ──
                if fmt_srt:
                    srt_lines = []
                    for i, seg in enumerate(segments, 1):
                        t_start = seg["start"]
                        t_end   = seg["end"]
                        text    = seg["text"].strip()
                        srt_lines.append("{}\n{} --> {}\n{}\n".format(
                            i,
                            _fmt_srt_time(t_start),
                            _fmt_srt_time(t_end),
                            text,
                        ))
                    srt_path = out_dir / "transcript.srt"
                    srt_path.write_text("\n".join(srt_lines), encoding="utf-8")
                    saved.append(str(srt_path))

                # ── JSON ──
                if fmt_json:
                    import json as _json
                    json_path = out_dir / "transcript.json"
                    json_path.write_text(
                        _json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                        encoding="utf-8"
                    )
                    saved.append(str(json_path))

                msg = "✅ Transcription terminée !\n" + "\n".join(
                    "  📄 {}".format(p) for p in saved)
                self.after(0, lambda m=msg: self._finish(True, m))

            except Exception as e:
                self.after(0, lambda err=e: self._finish(
                    False, "❌ Erreur : {}".format(err)))

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    def _finish(self, ok, msg):
        self._prog.stop()
        self._prog.set(1.0 if ok else 0.0)
        self._prog_lbl.configure(
            text="✅ Terminé" if ok else "❌ Échec",
            text_color=COLORS["success"] if ok else COLORS["error"],
        )
        self._log.append(msg)
        self._busy = False
        self._btn.configure(state="normal", text="  🎙  Lancer la transcription")


def _fmt_srt_time(seconds: float) -> str:
    """Convertit des secondes en format SRT : HH:MM:SS,mmm"""
    ms  = int((seconds % 1) * 1000)
    s   = int(seconds)
    h   = s // 3600
    m   = (s % 3600) // 60
    s   = s % 60
    return "{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d},{:03d}".format(h, m, s, ms)


# ─── Fenêtre principale ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class MediaForge(ctk.CTk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("MediaForge")
        self.geometry("980x820")
        self.minsize(820, 660)
        self.configure(fg_color=COLORS["bg"])
        self._build_titlebar()
        self._build_tabs()

    def _build_titlebar(self):
        bar = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color=COLORS["panel"], height=60, corner_radius=0)
        bar.pack(fill="x")
        bar.pack_propagate(False)

        lf = ctk.CTkFrame(bar, fg_color="transparent")
        lf.pack(side="left", padx=20, pady=10)
        ctk.CTkLabel(lf, text="⚡ MediaForge", font=("Segoe UI", 18, "bold"),
                     text_color=COLORS["accent"]).pack(side="left")
        ctk.CTkLabel(lf, text="  — Convertisseur multimédia", font=FONTS["body"],
                     text_color=COLORS["muted"]).pack(side="left")

        badge = ctk.CTkFrame(bar, fg_color=COLORS["card"], corner_radius=20)
        badge.pack(side="right", padx=20, pady=14)
        ctk.CTkLabel(badge, text="FFmpeg ✓", font=FONTS["small"],
                     text_color=COLORS["success"]).pack(padx=12, pady=4)

    def _build_tabs(self):
        tv = ctk.CTkTabview(
            self,
            fg_color=COLORS["bg"],
            segmented_button_fg_color=COLORS["panel"],
            segmented_button_selected_color=COLORS["accent4"],
            segmented_button_selected_hover_color="#E55A25",
            segmented_button_unselected_color=COLORS["panel"],
            segmented_button_unselected_hover_color=COLORS["border"],
            text_color=COLORS["text"],
            corner_radius=0,
        )
        tv.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        monitor_frame  = tv.add("📡  Moniteur Lives")
        recorder_frame = tv.add("🔴  Live Recorder")
        publish_frame  = tv.add("🚀  Publier")
        mp4_frame      = tv.add("🎬  Vidéo → MP4")
        regen_frame    = tv.add("🖼  Vignette & Sprite")
        transcript_frame = tv.add("🎙  Transcript")

        monitor_tab  = LiveMonitorTab(monitor_frame)
        monitor_tab.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        recorder_tab = LiveRecorderTab(recorder_frame, registry_tab=monitor_tab)
        recorder_tab.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        PublishTab(publish_frame).pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        VideoToMP4Tab(mp4_frame).pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        RegenerateTab(regen_frame).pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        TranscriptTab(transcript_frame).pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        tv.set("🔴  Live Recorder")


# ─── Point d'entrée ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = MediaForge()
    app.mainloop()
